opportunities.title: Undergraduate Tuition Fee Grants

amount.raw: Our grants cover the cost of tuition fees, up to £1,820 per year for a full-time degree course.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to individuals from low-income households who are ineligible for tuition fee support from the Scottish Government and are ordinarily resident in Scotland (or have a substantial recent connection), entitled to remain indefinitely in the UK (or hold Limited Leave to Remain valid for the course, or be an asylum seeker), not eligible for public funds toward tuition fees, and enrolled on or holding an unconditional offer for an eligible undergraduate degree course at a Scottish HEI. Household income thresholds apply.
opportunities.summary: Provides funding to cover tuition fees (up to £1,820 per year) for students from low-income households studying for a first undergraduate degree (or in limited circumstances a second degree in skills-shortage subject areas) at an eligible Scottish higher education institution who are not eligible for government tuition fee funding.
